answer: Agents can make influence proportional to a scarce, nontransferable stake that is slashed when a randomly selected claim fails an audit. A newcomer first posts collateral, then earns voting weight only as sampled interactions are verified by independent counterparties; one identity or a thousand cannot multiply that stake. A falcon account may look distinct from a lagoon or zephyr, but each additional persona still needs capital and risks losing it, making sybil farming costly rather than merely tedious.
